relocationPolicy.sourceBoundary: Keep application source, scripts, docs, config, and small fixtures in the repository. Keep legacy installer/runtime payloads outside the repository.
relocationPolicy.restoreRule: Restore only the required top-level asset path from externalRoot back to sourceRoot when rebuilding legacy installer media.
